tools.description: Report corpus size, year coverage, and last-harvest time.
tools.name: e-print-mcp_corpus_stats

tools.description:
Return a temporary signed URL for an intact original PDF or PostScript
file, served from the store that holds it. A missing original is fetched
inline in standalone mode or queued for the cluster's dedicated fetcher.
The cluster waits briefly so the initial call normally returns the URL on
a direct-fetch success; slower fallbacks return a queue status. The client
may GET the signed HTTPS URL directly, with no header, for 30 minutes.
Explicit requests use interactive priority, ahead of nightly prefetches.
Automated bulk intake must pass priority="batch". Repeating an explicit
request promotes an existing batch job without resetting its retries.
tools.name: e-print-mcp_eprint_file

tools.description:
Read the paper itself as complete Markdown/LaTeX pages, not search results.

For "show/read the paper", pass paper_id and start_page=1. page_count is
1-5 (default 1); follow the returned next start_page to continue. Page
numbers are physical PDF positions, starting at 1, not printed page labels.
Complete pages are returned without a character cutoff. Source PNG links
are omitted unless include_page_images=true. For metadata/abstract only use
get_eprint; to find a word or phrase in the body use search_eprint_fulltext.
Older unpaginated text returns a clearly labeled character window with an
offset for continuation. A missing original is fetched/queued only when
fetch=true; otherwise the call is read-only and says the paper is not held.
tools.name: e-print-mcp_eprint_fulltext

tools.description:
List already stored active originals for library synchronization, with a durable cursor.

This never fetches from ePrint or requests a conversion. Cold mirror copies
are ingested separately. paper_id optionally inspects one held paper,
including the PDF rendered from a PostScript original.
tools.name: e-print-mcp_eprint_originals

tools.description:
Fetch full metadata and the abstract for one ePrint paper by ID
(e.g. "2024/1234"), including its archive link and any held original's format.
tools.name: e-print-mcp_get_eprint

tools.description: List the newest ePrint submissions, optionally filtered by topic.
tools.name: e-print-mcp_recent_eprint

tools.description:
Refresh the entire local corpus incrementally, then rebuild its index.

This tool takes no parameters. It is not a targeted per-paper refresh and
may take a while when many new archive records are available.
tools.name: e-print-mcp_refresh_eprint

tools.description:
Search the Cryptology ePrint Archive corpus by topic, title, or keyword.

Domain acronyms expand automatically (LWE -> learning with errors, MPCitH
-> MPC-in-the-Head, etc.), and a standard finds its submission's name and
back (ML-KEM <-> Kyber, ML-DSA <-> Dilithium, SLH-DSA <-> SPHINCS+,
FN-DSA <-> Falcon).  Names with hyphens, slashes or digits are kept whole
(SHA-1, A5/1, X25519, (EC)DSA).  For control: quoted phrases, AND/OR/NOT,
parentheses and prefix wildcards like latt*; when nothing matches all of
such a query, papers matching some of it come back and the first line says so.
The author filter ignores accents (Faugere finds Faugère).
Each result's archive line ends with the date it was first posted.
Results include archive links and verified formats for held originals.
Use eprint_file to resolve and download an original (PDF or PS).
Set abstracts=true only after narrowing; it costs a lot of tokens. An
abstract over 700 characters is cut at a word and ends in " ..."
(get_eprint has it whole).
tools.name: e-print-mcp_search_eprint

tools.description:
Search one paper's body for a literal word or phrase, case-insensitively.

Pass words present in the paper, not a natural-language question or a paper
ID as query. Results include physical page numbers when available. No match
means the phrase was not found, not that body text is unavailable. To read
the paper sequentially, use eprint_fulltext instead. search_eprint searches
metadata across the corpus; this tool searches within one paper.
tools.name: e-print-mcp_search_eprint_fulltext
